footer.title: Conversation file records
footer.cumulative: Collected records for this task and its sub-agents only; never previous tasks or a complete audit
footer.knownLines: Latest known diff lines (not cumulative net changes)
footer.legacy: Includes legacy records without canonical file identity
footer.diffUnavailable: No text diff is available for this record (not collected or empty).
footer.diffBinary: This record is binary; a text diff cannot be displayed.
footer.diffSnapshot: Latest tool diff fixed at this task end, possibly truncated; not current disk contents or cumulative net changes.
footer.diffIncomplete: A diff hunk is incomplete or cannot be parsed, possibly due to truncation. Only received text is shown; missing content or line numbers are not invented.
footer.diffLimit: To keep the card responsive, only the first {{count}} patch lines are shown; this is not the complete diff.
footer.noNewline: No newline at this point (original marker preserved)
footer.clickHint: Click to expand/collapse inline diff; {{modifier}}+click to open the current file
footer.taskUnavailable: The current host lacks message footer slot support; task file cards cannot be displayed. Complete the task on a supporting host build.
footer.openUpgrade: Update the host to enable opening files
footer.deletedFile: This record is a deletion; the deleted file cannot be viewed
footer.remoteUnavailable: This card cannot open remote documents; remote paths are never treated as local files.
footer.invalidPath: An absolute path is required to safely open this file
footer.openError: The file open request failed. Check that the host supports the file reader action.
unavailable: File records for this task are unavailable. This does not mean zero files changed.
coverageMissing: Current-conversation coverage data is missing; coverage is unknown.
